Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Stream wrapper and sink callback lifecycle reviewed. The framework calls abort
but cannot establish provider rollback success because abort returns void. Sealing a sink
is staging, not activation; provider implementation and storage durability remain
distinct. Normal behavior excludes named mutation-test macros.
